verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists an "Ask Fellow" feature, and Fellow automatically produces AI summaries, suggested action items, decisions and minutes for every meeting. That points to some built-in AI assistance, but it is only a thin mention with no description of delegating tasks to an in-product assistant. The MCP server lets external chatbots like Claude or ChatGPT query Fellow data, which is not a built-in assistant and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of what Ask Fellow does, evidence that users can delegate actions or tasks (beyond Q&A or automatic summaries) to the built-in assistant, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
